title: Recovery and Renewal
definition: Recovery and renewal is the ongoing process of healing, growth, restoration, repentance, and transformation through the grace of God and the power of the Holy Spirit.
summary: Recovery is more than escaping destructive behaviors or surviving difficult circumstances. Biblical recovery is a journey of becoming more like Christ. Through repentance, truth, accountability, prayer, discipleship, and dependence upon God's grace, believers experience ongoing renewal. Though growth may be slow at times, God faithfully continues His transforming work in those who belong to Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ not only saves people from sin but also renews hearts, minds, relationships, and lives through His ongoing work of sanctification.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people become discouraged when change takes longer than expected. Understanding biblical renewal helps believers remain patient and hopeful, trusting that God works progressively rather than instantly in many areas of life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Celebrate progress without becoming prideful. Do not allow setbacks to convince you that God has abandoned you. Continue pursuing Scripture, prayer, fellowship, accountability, and obedience while trusting Christ to complete the work He has begun.
